title: How do you design and rig 3d or 2.5d characters?
author: mike_good
selftext:
I am a complete newbie trying to figure out the best way to create and rig 3D or 2.5D characters for animated storytelling videos.

My goal is to have reusable characters that can:

Move their arms, legs, head, and body.

Display facial expressions (happy, sad, surprised, angry, etc.).

Animate their mouths for speech (lip-sync).

Be reused across multiple videos with different animations.

I'm aiming for relatively simple, stylized characters, nothing overly complex or realistic.

What tools, workflows, or existing templates would you recommend for a beginner? Ideally, I'd like to automate parts of the process using code or AI.

Any advice or pointers to tutorials would be greatly appreciated!

comments.author: Suitable-Chest262
comments.body: I use tripo3d for design and rig.

comments.author: atluina
comments.body:
2.5D characters are harder to do, it requires much more effort. So I would say just purchase some assets, or get ready to put in a lot of effort into that.

So, you might need to go with 3D. There are AI 3d modeling tools (10-30 dollars a month), you can make some characters with it. 

But face expressions... You will need to learn how to do "blend shape" or whatever the name of it is in the 3D software that you use. Basically giving some shapes as poses to meshes, and playing them in-game.

If you want to go 2D, however. You can get simple character, split it into pieces with AI, tell AI to rig it, fix the problems and ask for animations afterwards. Since it will be simple 2D, separating pieces with AI will be easy, and changing face expressions will be way easier than 2,5D or 3D character.

comments.author: TraplineStudio
comments.body: For the body, Mixamo auto-rigs simple humanoids and has a big free animation library, so you don't have to rig anything yourself. Faces are easier with shape keys in Blender, one per expression plus a handful of mouth shapes. Rhubarb Lip Sync can then turn your voice audio into those mouth shapes automatically.
